Central

SEN-truhl · adjective

Hear It

What It Means

Central is in or near the middle; most important.

The water fountain is in the central hallway, right in the middle of the school.

Worked Example

Kindness is the central idea of the whole story.

The story is mostly about kindness - it is the idea everything else connects to. Central can mean in the middle or most important.

How Central Sits Among Its Neighbors

Synonyms — open each to see how it differs

middle

middle: halfway between the edges

main

main: most important

Antonyms

outer

outer: away from the middle

minor

minor: less important

How Strong Is It? — Important → central → Essential

Important vs. central

Important vs. central: Important is milder: many characters are important to a story.

Essential vs. central

Essential vs. central: Essential is stronger: the central idea is essential - cut it out and the story falls apart.

Put it together

Put it together: Centr- means the center point, so central describes what sits in the middle - of a place or of an idea.
